text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Spring checkpoint cleared! Hwooo-chaah!
Behold the birth of the Matikane Rising Dragon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Not that the name actually changes or anything, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, did you see that, Trainer?
My luck is soaring all the way to the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~! I gave it my all like it was
a once-in-a-lifetime showdown! Or rather, the god did!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time for the next race fortune-telling!
Come on, surely anyone can guess this one, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Since the first leg of the Classics is next,
it's only natural... Now, let the divination begin!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll go ahead and draw quickly this time.
I wonder what it'll be~ Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ge-ge-geh~?! The Japan Derby?!
Why? How come?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Not the Satsuki Sho, but straight to the Derby? What are you thinking, God?!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's a trial from the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"An ordeal... Ugh, that's exactly what it is.
The race that decides the pinnacle of the Classic season, yearned for by every Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood! If this is destiny, I accept it! Will you keep me company?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, thank goodness~. If you say so,
Trainer, I'll at least take part in it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's jog on over and buy some commemorative goods
as charms! And a goshuin stamp too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do that too, you know! Even if someone like me
tries her hardest, it's not gonna amount to much though!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... I'd at least like to give it everything I have.
It is such a grand festival, after all."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Impurity has no place on a celebratory day! With a refreshed spirit,
I want to tie my fortune slip to Fuchu's great zelkova tree!
